ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case is not in the Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue and the Record Type is not ATM Dispute or Card Dispute.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute'), OR( Owner:Queue.QueueName != 'Card Disputes - General Queue', Owner:Queue.QueueName != 'Card Disputes - Fraud Queue') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this Dispute Type, please select either Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue.
